text:
Sam G: quick check — noticed an odd spike in leads from the referral pipeline around 10:30 PST, but conversion rate on the demo flow dropped. anyone else seeing this on Pulseboard?
Mina Patel: saw it. traffic up from /launch-post but sessions are short, CTR high on CTA but form completions down :thinking_face:
Jorge Alvarez: same. my hypothesis — messaging mismatch after the new hero copy. we swapped copy at 09:50 via CDN swap. could be quality of traffic change.
Ella Chen: i pulled the paid channel slices — paid CPL stable, org referral traffic is 3x and seems to be bot-like (short session length < 4s). leaving note on the dashboard: https://pulseboard.internal/r/213
Sam G: thanks. can someone run a quick query to confirm source breakdown and form error rate? if it's bot traffic we should route to lead-scrub rather than sales until we confirm.
Tess (growth-ops): running a quick look now. SQL I ran:
```
SELECT source, count(*) as hits, avg(session_seconds) as avg_sess, sum(form_error) as form_errors
FROM web.events
WHERE received_at > '2026-03-20T08:00:00Z'
GROUP BY source
ORDER BY hits DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
Tess (growth-ops): preliminary: referral-domain-x accounts for 68% of spike, avg_sess 2.1s, form_errors +3.2% vs baseline.
Mina Patel: that aligns with the lower demo conversions. can we flag those leads as low-confidence and pause the webhook to SFDC for that source?
Jorge Alvarez: yes — recommend we add a quick rule in the routing table: if source==referral-domain-x and avg_sess < 5 then tag=qc-low and route->lead-queue-scrub. I can push change if ops-greenlight.
Sam G: ok let's do that as a stopgap. @Tess, can you prepare the routing change and a rollback plan? include expected impact on weekly metrics.
Tess (growth-ops): will do. i'll schedule a 15m window and include rollback script. expected effected leads ~1.6k/day, should drop raw lead volume but raise demo conversion %.
Ella Chen: also let's capture a snapshot of the dashboard and a before/after for the weekly report. add a note to the MPR (marketing performance report) doc.
Sam G: agree. for messaging iteration: @Jorge can you revert hero copy A/B to previous variant on a small percentage while we triage? if traffic quality improves we know it's a copy + referrer interplay.
Jorge Alvarez: on it. will roll 10% revert for 2h and monitor. i'll post updates in this thread.
growth-bot: Weekly digest posted — MPR snapshot uploaded to /shared/mpr/2026-03-20. Summary: topline leads +12%, qualified leads -4%, note on referral spike.
Mina Patel: thanks bot. action list: 1) Tess routing rule + rollback 2) Jorge revert 10% 3) Ella snapshot to MPR 4) Sam follow up with sales. i'll draft a short comms note for reps.
Sam G: perfect. if we don't see improvement in 3h we escalate to SRE for deeper bot-detection. thanks team :thumbsup:
